text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain 11,000 ft and the pilot monitoring read back 11,000 ft. The pilot flying set 11,000 ft in the MCP and climbed, with the aircraft rising from 8,980 ft through 10,820 ft. Crosscheck stayed silent, which was right because the clearance, the readback and the setting agreed.
